skills.name: Whip attack
skills.description: A left-handed bladed lash extends and cracks like a whip twice, an overhand strike and a rising underhand one, both forward at the tile ahead, then recoils and falls. Damage, gameplay reach, costs and cooldown are not defined; the two animated strikes do not establish two gameplay hits.

skills.name: Sovereign Kiss
skills.description: A blown kiss becomes a large heart of pink fog that passes through opponents, enthralls eligible targets and dissolves beyond the formation. Cast with the free right hand while the left keeps the whip lowered. Target count, duration, resistance, range, cost and cooldown remain undecided.
